title: The inbound response-time promise
content: Every inbound lead gets a human-approved first touch within the response budget recorded on this workflow's installation (four working hours unless changed). The budget is counted in working hours only: time outside the working day, at weekends, or during an out-of-office window does not consume it. A lead that passes its budget is not abandoned — it is escalated to the top of the next sweep and labelled overdue.

title: First-touch emails are drafted, never sent automatically
content: The assistant drafts the first touch and posts it for approval. It does not send outbound email to an inbound lead on its own, and it does not add a lead to a sequence. A person approves, edits or discards every draft. This holds even when the response budget has already expired.
